item.title: JBL’s versatile new EasySing Mic range can be used for karaoke, podcasts and live streaming
item.summary: JBL has released a versatile range of EasySing pocket-sized microphones that can be used for karaoke, podcasting, and live streams. The JBL EasySing Mics, JBL EasySing Mic Mini and the JBL EasySing Mic Mini Duo been designed to suit multiple uses and multiple stages.
